description.value:
As a Bonus Action, you can magically transform into a creature of living flame. In this form, you have Resistance to piercing, bludgeoning, and slashing damage as well as Immunity to fire damage and poison.

Additionally, if a creature hits you with a melee attack from within 10 ft or touches you, it takes fire damage equal to half your sorcerer level. Additionally, you add your Charisma modifier to the damage of all the other features gained from this subclass that deal fire damage.

You remain in this form for 1 minute. It ends early if you are Incapacitated, if you die, or if you dismiss it as a Bonus Action.

Once you have used this feature, you cannot use it again until you have finished a Long Rest, unless you spend 6 sorcery points to use it again.
